comments.author: niklasahr
comments.body: CPU SPIN: the retry loop sleeps in a tight loop and will peg a core at 100% for the whole backoff window. Spinning like this under every outage is unacceptable!

comments.author: brittalund
comments.body: Looked at the actual primitive: it is a bounded timer sleep, not a spin — total worst-case wait is 30s across 5 attempts, confirmed with the timing test. No spinning core; resolving as invalid.
